recognize_zh: 大型淋巴球的胞質豐富、淡藍色，靠近邊緣（與紅血球接觸處）顏色較深，胞質被周圍紅血球擠壓出稜角形外廓，核大、形狀不規則、染色質略疏鬆；這種「抱住紅血球」的外觀是反應性（非典型）淋巴球的特徵。
features: Large lymphocyte with an irregular, angular outline molded by adjacent red cells
Abundant cytoplasm that is pale centrally with deeper basophilia at the periphery where it contacts red cells
Large irregular nucleus with moderately condensed but somewhat open chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with abundant cytoplasm whose borders are indented and molded by adjacent erythrocytes, with peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia accentuated at points of contact. The nucleus is large and irregular with moderately condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus. The cell lacks granules and vacuoles. Findings are consistent with a reactive (atypical, Downey type II) lymphocyte, as seen in viral infections such as infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have a high N:C ratio, fine immature chromatin with nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, unlike this cell's abundant cytoplasm and more mature chromatin.
Monocytes have gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine granules and a folded lacy nucleus, without peripheral basophilia molding around red cells.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with circumferential fine hair-like projections and are CD11c/CD25/CD103-positive B cells.
LGLs contain discrete azurophilic granules and have a round condensed nucleus.
